<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Economic Growth Outlook:</strong> Moody’s has upgraded India’s FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7%, citing economic resilience, though it cautioned that rising inflation risks remain a concern for the outlook.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQbk80WURWcTFnQmtlenhXS1lMcVc5TGZHRkVUYWhTanp2YWFwdDV4dWdkVEJCWG9pRmt0aDhjd2VfdFZDQ0lkbnZONXZGdnd2MU9vck9GUmlMMldGZEw0N2hvTmxNQXgzdEFQenU2OHJxSnZRUFI4b29jcmU5M3V0S3YtVmRPM0VHcUFoeDRBWV9lUlF5?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
